rules.label: tokenUsage
rules.reason: Legacy usage object. Use ModelTrace.usage.

rules.label: conclusionNotice
rules.reason: Legacy fallback notice. Use AgentConclusion.notice for user-facing notices and ModelTrace for fallback / model error state.

rules.label: agentConclusion.source
rules.reason: AgentConclusion owns text and notice only. Use ModelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: agentConclusion.conclusionSource
rules.reason: Conclusion source belongs to ModelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: agentConclusion.fallbackReason
rules.reason: Fallback reason belongs to ModelTrace.fallbackReason.

rules.label: agentConclusion.modelErrorType
rules.reason: Model error type belongs to ModelTrace.modelErrorType.

rules.label: agentConclusion.content
rules.reason: Use AgentConclusion.markdownText and AgentConclusion.plainText.

rules.label: agentConclusion.summary
rules.reason: Use AgentConclusion.sections or AgentConclusion.notice.

rules.label: metadata.clientRunId
rules.reason: clientRunId is only pending / idempotency state, not persisted metadata relationship.

rules.label: modelTrace.tokenUsage
rules.reason: Legacy model trace field. Use modelTrace.usage.

rules.label: usage ?? tokenUsage
rules.reason: Old/new fallback chain. Normalize usage once in mapper.

rules.label: tokenUsage || usage
rules.reason: Old/new fallback chain. Normalize usage once in mapper.

rules.label: rawRun.conclusionSource ?? 'mock'
rules.reason: Mock source must be explicit and not a raw fallback.

rules.label: metadata.provider
rules.reason: Provider must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.selectedModelId
rules.reason: Selected model id must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.model
rules.reason: Model must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.conclusionSource
rules.reason: Conclusion source must come from canonical modelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: metadata.usage
rules.reason: Usage must come from canonical modelTrace.usage.

rules.label: metadata.costEstimate
rules.reason: Cost estimate must come from canonical modelTrace.costEstimate.

rules.label: metadata.fallbackReason
rules.reason: Fallback reason must come from canonical modelTrace.fallbackReason.

rules.label: metadata.modelErrorType
rules.reason: Model error type must come from canonical modelTrace.modelErrorType.
